trigger: Age exactly 30 game days
expected: Not eligible under current strict greater-than gate.

trigger: Age 30 game days plus one second
expected: Eligible if all other protection and source checks pass.

trigger: Wall clock advances while game time is fixed
expected: Eligibility unchanged.

trigger: Later summary of day10 and day11 is compacted again
expected: Keep original source time range, not creation time as event time.

trigger: 1000 routine episodes for one NPC are summarized repeatedly
expected: Measure post-encoding bytes; bounded active-generation target; no growing list of all source hashes.

trigger: All candidates have high emotion
expected: Landmark allocation remains bounded; stronger evidence gets detail, no unlimited importance exception.

trigger: Open commitments exceed budget
expected: Preserve authoritative commitments, report protected overflow; do not claim a hard total cap.

trigger: No eligible old material and recent buffer above target
expected: Keep evidence, report backlog and apply explicit producer backpressure; no silent deletion.

trigger: Malformed or source-unfaithful summary twice repaired unsuccessfully
expected: Keep original sources; mark unresolved; zero reclaim permission.

trigger: Append happens during summary generation
expected: Reject exact-head publication or explicitly rebase unmodified captured range; never drop appended turns.

trigger: Load another save before completion
expected: Reject old owner/save epoch/branch callback.

trigger: Personality or accepted-appraisal fingerprint changes
expected: Reject stale selection context; retry from a fresh snapshot.

trigger: Crash before new generation files are flushed
expected: Old checkpoint remains readable; incomplete staging ignored.

trigger: Crash after generation write but before actual successful game save
expected: Old root retained; no collection based solely on GetSaveData.

trigger: Disk full or invalid generation reload
expected: Publication rejected; original retained.

trigger: Crash after save commit before reclaim
expected: New generation readable; old data remains harmless surplus.

trigger: Retained old save points to raw parent
expected: Raw parent pinned; active generation can still be independent.

trigger: Unknown or inaccessible save directory
expected: Disable reclamation; report incomplete root census.

trigger: Export reader pins a generation
expected: Reclamation waits for reader/export pin release.

trigger: Rewind before a betrayal then save a new branch
expected: No future betrayal appears in the new branch.

trigger: Export compacted save then import into empty archive
expected: All referenced dependencies included; load succeeds without deleted raw chunks.

trigger: Load or import existing version1 archive package
expected: Legacy reader remains supported; no forced destructive conversion.

trigger: Old applied receipt is replayed after consumed-inbox compaction
expected: Reject replay; no second mood/trust/inventory effect.

trigger: Legacy producer has no durable monotonic sequence
expected: Retain exact replay protection; no probabilistic-only deletion or false exactly-once claim.

trigger: Any nearby NPC approaches during background model work
expected: Cancel/yield and reject late result; proximity is not limited to last speaker.

trigger: Dialogue or TTS starts during work
expected: Foreground queue wins; measure actual inference cancellation latency.

trigger: Combat, save/load or scene transition begins
expected: Stop batch publication and cancel inference; retain last valid generation.

trigger: Crowd leaves and returns repeatedly
expected: Quiet hysteresis/backoff avoids repeated immediate restart.

trigger: Twelve jobs exhausted and game day passes
expected: Budget resumes; cancellation cannot refresh attempts.

trigger: Run ten simulated game years at 100, 1000 and 10000 NPCs
expected: Report active archive, retained roots, inbox, accepted outcomes, RAM and load time separately.

trigger: Wedding event has two participant memories and a private detail
expected: Shared event ID; observer-specific visibility; do not invent cross-NPC synchronization.

trigger: Appraisal payload is pruned before its durable salience capsule exists
expected: Reject pruning; later summaries must retain accepted historical cue and attribution.

trigger: Eight-day-old long conversations exceed the recent-memory high-water mark
expected: Eligible for detail-preserving pressure compaction; significant specifics remain.

trigger: Eight-day-old ordinary conversations with no storage pressure
expected: Keep detailed episodes; do not force monthly-level compression early.

trigger: Six-day-old conversations exceed the high-water mark
expected: Keep detailed recent evidence and report overflow; pressure cannot bypass the seven-day floor.

trigger: Data pressure comes from many NPCs rather than one verbose NPC
expected: Aggregate recent-byte trigger activates fair batches across eligible NPCs; do not starve quieter NPCs.

trigger: Measured bytes fluctuate around the high-water threshold
expected: Separate low-water release threshold prevents repeated enter/exit oscillation.

trigger: Same significant event at eight days under pressure and at one hundred eighty days
expected: Early summary retains more specifics; old landmark keeps central meaning and attribution; both use personality/emotion.

trigger: Exactly seven game days under pressure
expected: Not eligible until strictly older than the configured seven-day floor.

trigger: Large current conversations only; all sources younger than seven days
expected: No eligible deletion; show protected backlog rather than falsely claiming bounded storage.
